jobs.title: Intake Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Come join an exciting and innovative company that puts the “care” back in healthcare!

  

At KabaFusion, our patients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire GREAT people, period! Our culture celebrates and supports the differences that make us unique. Here, it doesn’t matter what your role is, your hard work and dedication is not only recognized but celebrated. Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

  

About Us:


What started as a single pharmacy in 2010 has grown into KabaFusion becoming the largest privately held home infusion company in the country. We have a national network of pharmacies and nursing offices strategically placed to service 40\+ states. Couple that with over 30 years of combined experience and it’s no wonder why KabaFusion is the industry leader in home infusion.

  

Job Summary:  

This position is responsible for the coordination and supports the intake function, managing intake documentation, payor requirements, and cross\-functional scheduling to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations. This role blends operational rigor with light project management, serving as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to drive process improvements and maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


1\. Write, maintain, and update Intake Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to reflect current workflows, policy changes, and best practices.


2\. Maintain and update the payor handbook, including payor\-specific requirements, timelines, and submission guidelines; track policy changes and translate them into actionable process updates.


3\. Manage calendars and schedule intake\-related meetings across departments (operations, clinical, billing, etc.).


4\. Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, minutes, and follow\-up action items to ensure timely execution.


5\. Maintain project documentation for intake process improvement initiatives, including action logs, scope changes, and post\-project evaluations.


6\. Serve as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to support process improvement project implementation.


7\. Review, categorize, and ensure accurate and timely distribution of incoming faxes and other intake documentation to the appropriate department or stakeholders.


8\. Monitor intake processes for adherence to SOPs and payor requirements; identify recurring issues or bottlenecks and propose solutions.


9\. Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and organizational standards.


10\. Perform other duties as assigned by leadership to support departmental goals.

  

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


Education:

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

  

Experience:  

* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in operations, intake, project coordination, or a related role; healthcare or revenue cycle management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build stakeholder engagement and drive action.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and/or electronic health record or payor portal systems preferred. Skills and Competencies:
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams.

  

What we offer:

* Competitive compensation
* Benefits start on your 1st day of employment
* 401k w 4% match – no waiting or vesting period
* PTO / Floating Holidays / Paid Holidays
* Company paid life insurance, short term disability
* Employee Assistance programs to help with mental health / wellness
* Learning \& Development Programs
* Perks… includes discounts on travel, cell phone, clothing and more…
* Generous employee referral program

  

  

To learn more about KabaFusion, please visit our careers page: https://www.kabafusion.com/careers/

  

Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

As we grow across California and Arizona, we need a sharp, organized person on the ground in Anaheim who owns the details, closes the loops, and becomes the go\-to answer for our field crews.

This is the role that makes the whole operation work. If you're the kind of person who finishes what you start, thrives in records and spreadsheets, and takes real pride in being the reason nothing falls through the cracks — keep reading.

**What you'll do:**

**Own records and compliance.** Keep personnel files, driver/MVR records, certifications, and training current and audit\-ready. Manage customer compliance portals (ISN, Avetta, Highwire and others), handle COI requests, prequalification and safety questionnaires, and flag renewals 60 days out.

**Support our people.** Be the first stop for California employees on PTO balances, timecard questions, and system access. Coordinate the administrative side of onboarding — DocuSign packets, background checks, drug screening, PPE, first\-day logistics — and help team members navigate benefits enrollment.

**Keep projects on track.** Prepare weekly job\-cost meeting materials, flag variances, and keep change\-order and PO logs current. You'll get comfortable with core construction job\-cost concepts (budgets, labor hours, committed vs. actual costs) and know when to raise your hand.

**Carry the follow\-through.** Track action items across California operations — site\-visit follow\-ups, training completion, kickoff requirements — and drive each one to the finish. Deliver a weekly budget\-to\-actual report to leadership before anyone has to ask.

**Be the local presence.** Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for the California field, coordinate office and equipment needs, set up vendors, and manage device inventory. Respond same\-day.

**What we're looking for:**

* A finisher. You close the loop instead of just opening it.
* Detail\-oriented and genuinely comfortable in records, portals, and spreadsheets.
* Strong communicator who people trust to give them a straight answer.
* Steady and dependable — the calm, reliable presence a busy field team can count on.
* Bonus: exposure to construction, electrical, or trades operations.

**Why this role is worth your time:**

This seat has real room to grow. As our California region expands, this is a role we expect to develop toward greater operations leadership over time. We're hiring for that trajectory — bring your ambition.

**The details:**

* **Location:** Anaheim, CA — on\-site
* **Schedule:** Full\-time
* **Pay:** $70,000–$80,000 per year
* **Reports to:** Operations Manager

Ready to apply?

We're looking to fill this role right away. Apply today with your resume, and tell us in a sentence or two why you're the person who gets things done.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager, Los Angeles, CA - Mortgage Insurance
jobs.description:
**Essent Group Ltd.** (NYSE: ESNT) is a Bermuda\-based holding company (collectively with its subsidiaries, "Essent") which serves the housing finance industry by offering private mortgage insurance, reinsurance, risk management products and title insurance and settlement services to mortgage lenders, borrowers, and investors to support homeownership. We are focused on managing risk and dedicated to serving as a strong and fair counterparty. As a company, we bring strong private capital and a commitment to risk management to the mortgage insurance industry.

  


**Title**: Account Manager

  


**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (Remote)



This is a key role within the team that acts as an individual contributor which operates under limited supervision. The Account Manager will represent Essent to small and midsized lenders. Responsible for the advancement of lender relationships to maximize Essent’s position within the assigned account base and development of new market opportunities.
 

**As a dynamic and resourceful professional, we will rely on you to perform the following duties:**


* Represent Essent to assigned accounts within a specified regional territory to deliver value added credit enhancement solutions while driving profit to the business.
* Responsible for the success and profitability of each account.
* Represent Essent to designated lender “Key Locations” within the assigned territory.
* Develop a thorough understanding of assigned accounts with respective business models and obtain detailed knowledge of how they operate.
* Build strong client relationships to support current business needs and acquire new customers.
* Collaborate with internal departments to fulfill customer’s request.
* Identify market opportunities, structures, and penetration strategies for new products/programs to fit clients’ needs and help differentiate Essent in the market.
* Work in collaboration with clients, internal operations, and credit policy to manage coordination of product, pricing, and credit implementation programs.
* Meet timelines for each client’s initiative, request and project, including implementation, client and internal roll\-out, collateral and presentation materials.
* Evaluate competitive market trends and new regulations related to products, rates, guidelines, and/or ancillary services.
* Develop tactics to leverage current market trends and optimize sales potential.
* Develop understanding of GSE requirements for mortgage insurance industry, PMIERs and Master Policy.
* Facilitate and educate clients on new programs, rates, products, and initiatives.
* Focus on profitability and mutually beneficial arrangements with regional accounts to create a sustainable alignment of interest.
* Explore cost effective origination strategies capitalizing on Essent’s strengths while delivering superior customer service.
* Represent Essent at client meetings, attend regional, state conferences, trade shows and events to promote Essent’s product offerings and broaden the business exposure within the mortgage industry.
* Present Essent within the entire mortgage industry as thought leaders, disciplined risk managers and a strong focus on servicing our customers.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.


**Minimum Education \& Experience Requirements:**


* Bachelor ‘s degree strongly preferred.
* Three (3\) years or more of relevant business development experience within financial services or mortgage industry.
* Solid understanding of the economics of mortgage banking and how Essent’s customers operate and profit, required.
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Due to Essent’s unique culture within the mortgage insurance industry, the successful candidate must demonstrate a personal initiative towards helping to build a successful company, the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and get work done and possess strong work ethic and entrepreneurial skills.
* Ability to travel up to approximately 30%.
* Account base is concentrated in a regional or state footprint. Preferred that candidates live within their market.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills are required.
* Excellent verbal, written communication, and presentation skills.
* A demonstrated history of leadership and ownership, along with the ability to drive strategic initiatives from concept to completion.
* Ability to interact with senior level decision makers, vendors and clients in a professional manner and discuss Essent and its products and services at a high level.
* Experience developing and cultivating relationships with customers, clients, vendors and colleagues of various levels and backgrounds.
* Strong time management, organizational and planning skills.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, drive and work ethic.

  



Our commitment to your success is enhanced by our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401(k) and disability benefits. We work to maintain a positive environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. Essent is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday  
**Compensation:** 65k salary \+ Tiered Commission  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, W\-2

About the Role

We are looking for a competitive, driven Logistics Sales Representative who knows how to build relationships, create opportunities, follow up aggressively, and turn prospects into long\-term customers.

This is not a cradle\-to\-grave logistics position.

Our sales team is structured so that sales representatives can focus on what they do best: **prospecting, developing relationships, identifying opportunities, and winning business.**

You will work alongside a Sales Leader who will assist with strategy and closing opportunities. Once an account is won and properly transitioned, our Operations Team manages the day\-to\-day execution of the freight.

We provide the systems, resources, operational support, and sales infrastructure. We expect our salespeople to bring urgency, discipline, persistence, and results.

What You'll Do

* Prospect and develop new B2B customer relationships
* Generate outbound calls, emails, referrals, and new opportunities
* Work company\-generated leads and independently generated opportunities
* Qualify prospects based on shipping volume, lanes, service requirements, and opportunity
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with prospects
* Conduct discovery calls and customer meetings
* Work with the Sales Leader to develop pricing and closing strategies
* Present solutions and overcome customer objections
* Maintain accurate pipeline activity in the company's CRM/TMS
* Properly transition newly won customers to Operations
* Continue maintaining the commercial relationship after onboarding
* Build a profitable and sustainable book of business

How Success Is Measured

We care about profitable business, not simply top\-line revenue.

Performance will be evaluated based on factors including:

* Qualified opportunities generated
* Sales activity and pipeline development
* Meetings and proposals
* New customers acquired
* Gross profit generated
* Margin quality
* Conversion rate
* Customer retention
* Pipeline accuracy and follow\-up discipline

Who We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Are naturally competitive and goal\-oriented
* Are comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls
* Know how to build rapport quickly
* Are persistent without being unprofessional
* Can handle rejection without losing momentum
* Understand that follow\-up wins business
* Are organized and accountable
* Can communicate professionally by phone and email
* Can think commercially instead of simply discounting to win business
* Want coaching and are comfortable being measured by performance

Preferred Experience

* B2B sales experience preferred
* Logistics, freight brokerage, transportation, supply chain, 3PL, or freight forwarding experience is a plus
* Experience with CRM or TMS systems is a plus
* Proven history of meeting sales goals is strongly preferred

Candidates from other high\-performance B2B sales environments are encouraged to apply if they can demonstrate strong prospecting and closing ability.

Compensation

This is a W\-2 position offering:

* Competitive base salary
* Tiered commission structure
* Opportunity to increase earnings based on performance
* Sales leadership and closing support
* Operational support after customer onboarding
* Company\-provided systems and sales resources

Our Environment

We are building a high\-performance sales organization.

We value people who take ownership, communicate directly, solve problems, stay accountable, and want to grow.

We are not looking for someone who needs to be constantly pushed to follow up.

We are looking for someone who wants to win.

Hiring Process

Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short sales case study before advancing to an interview. The exercise is designed to evaluate sales judgment, communication, commercial thinking, and problem\-solving ability.

Pay: From $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* You are working with a prospect that could generate significant monthly revenue. They like your service but tell you that another logistics provider is 8% cheaper and ask you to match the price. Your current pricing produces a healthy margin, but matching their rate would make the account much less profitable. How would you approach the conversation? Explain what questions you would ask, how you would determine whether to negotiate, and what alternatives you might offer. We want to understand how you balance closing business with protecting company profitability.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Help Us Build the Next Version of Our Operations Team**

We are a growing logistics company, and we are looking for people who want to do more than simply perform a job.

We want **critical thinkers, passionate workers, problem solvers, and future leaders** who are excited about helping build a company while it is growing.

Our company is still evolving. That means not every process is perfect, not every problem has already been solved, and not every system has already been built.

**That is the opportunity.**

If you are the type of person who notices inefficiencies and immediately starts thinking about how they could be improved, we want to meet you.

If you enjoy solving problems, creating structure, taking ownership, and making an operation better than you found it, this may be the right environment for you.

You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas, improve workflows, challenge inefficient processes, and help shape how our Operations Department functions as the company grows.

We are not looking for someone who only asks:

**“What do you want me to do?”**

We are looking for someone who also asks:

**“Why are we doing it this way?”**

**“Is there a better way?”**

**“What problem are we trying to solve?”**

and

**“How can I help make this operation stronger?”**

The Logistics Operations Coordinator supports our Operations Leaders with the daily execution of customer freight while helping create the structure necessary for our company to scale.

You will work directly inside the operation: entering shipments, coordinating with carriers and drivers, tracking freight, helping with KPIS, maintaining documentation, communicating internally, and identifying problems before they become larger issues.

But this position is about more than completing transactions.

As you learn the operation, we expect you to **think critically about the work you are doing.**

Where are we losing time?

Where are mistakes happening?

What information is missing?

What could be automated?

What process could be simplified?

What could make communication between Sales and Operations better?

What could allow the company to handle more freight without sacrificing service?

Your ideas matter here.

Our goal is to build a team where employees do not simply work **inside** the operation—they help improve it.

What You'll Do

You will help manage the daily execution of freight by:

* Entering new shipments accurately into the TMS by creating templates being proactive
* Reviewing shipment information for missing, incomplete, or conflicting details
* Preparing and sending rate confirmations and shipment documentation
* Updating pickup and delivery appointments
* Tracking shipments and maintaining accurate status updates
* Communicating routine shipment updates to customers
* Following up with carriers and drivers
* Obtaining PODs and required documentation
* Maintaining organized and complete load records
* Assisting Operations Leaders with carrier sourcing
* Communicating with vendors regarding availability and shipment requirements
* Identifying loads requiring immediate attention
* Escalating service failures and time\-sensitive issues
* Helping resolve missing information, documentation problems, and operational discrepancies
* Maintaining strong commun

Pay: $26\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* You have 6 active loads. One driver is late, one carrier has stopped responding, one customer wants an immediate update, one load still needs a carrier, and two loads need paperwork completed. You cannot complete everything at once. Explain how you would decide what to work on first and what you would escalate to your Operations Leader.

jobs.title: Admin Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Uses skills as a seasoned and experienced administrative operations professional to manage, plan, and administer operational and facilities functions for the Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI), spanning several locations. Provides day\-to\-day operational coordination for CNEI, ensuring consistent standards, procedures, and working conditions across multiple CNEI locations. Demonstrates good judgment in independently coordinating operational and administrative processes and prioritizing multi\-site logistics.


**Department Overview**

The Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI) is a support department with five main divisions: Nursing Professional Development, Nursing Quality and Analytics, Clinical Practice, Nursing Continuous Improvement and Research, and Magnet Recognition Program®. The Professional Development team includes Nursing Professional Development Specialists who oversee the Department of Nursing’s training and education needs. The Nursing Practice team includes Clinical Nurse Specialists and Advanced Practice Specialists, who oversee evidence\-based practice standards that optimize quality and safety patient outcomes. The Research \& Scholarship team includes Nurse Scientists and a Scholarship Development Specialist who oversee the infrastructure for clinical inquiry, research, and innovation. The Nursing Continuous Improvement team oversees continuous improvement and evidence\-based practice processes across the system. The Nursing Quality and Analytics team includes nursing quality analysts who oversee data production, dissemination, and analytics. The Magnet Program Director collaborates with CNEI, Nursing leaders, and the Nursing Department to advance excellence in accordance with Magnet Recognition Program® standards. The mission of the CNEI team is to prepare and support UCSF nurses to be expert clinicians and authentic leaders who provide high\-quality, compassionate care, foster the spirit of clinical inquiry, promote professional development, and enhance a culture of diversity and inclusivity.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of administrative operations or facilities coordination experience.
* Thorough knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for facilities and logistics.
* Interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
* Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as supply purchasing, expense tracking, event planning, inventory, equipment, and facilities record keeping.
  

Solid knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs (Office 365, Drupal, ServiceNow).
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Strong skills in short\-term planning, analysis, problem\-solving, and customer service.
* Strong customer service orientation across all locations and able to run operations on competing site\-level priorities.
* Ability to coordinate and prioritize work across multiple locations with minimal supervision.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of workplace safety regulations and experience serving as site safety coordinator or liaison.
* Project management certification from a reputable organization such as PMP, CSM, or ACP to include a qualifying exam and/or quality assurance processes like Six Sigma or Lean or equivalent project management experience.

jobs.title: Inbound Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About PredictHQ**


AI and forecasting systems have a blind spot: the real\-world conditions that shift demand land as surprises instead of signals. PredictHQ closes that gap. We're the real\-world context platform trusted by some of the world's largest enterprises, including Uber, Expedia, and CVS, explaining more than 60 percent of real\-world demand variability so businesses can make high\-stakes decisions on pricing, staffing, and inventory with confidence.

**Our Values**


PredictHQ is about teamwork to achieve huge things. We are building innovative and complex products, so our empathetic, hard\-working culture is key to our success. We are proactive in helping our teammates grow and thrive in their careers, as well as making sure everyone can put their family and friends first.  

  



We’re looking for a driven and strategic Inbound Sales Development Representative to join our growing Go\-to\-market team in San Francisco.


As an Inbound SDR at PredictHQ, you’ll be on the front lines of our revenue engine, helping drive pipeline and business growth. As a key member of our Sales team, you’ll engage with our prospects, building relationships with key stakeholders in enterprise organizations. Your role goes beyond lead qualification \- you’ll deeply understand our mission, value proposition, and product offerings to spark high\-value conversations with senior executives.


We're a small but high\-impact team, so we need someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is eager to make an immediate impact. You'll be joining a group that's creative in how it builds account strategy and genuinely enthusiastic and supportive of each other day\-to\-day. You’re just as comfortable conducting targeted research and crafting compelling messaging as you are jumping on a demo call. You’ll master sales automation tools, qualify inbound leads, and execute a multi\-threaded sales strategy \- all while refining messaging and optimising campaign performance.

**As an Inbound Sales Development Representative at PredictHQ, you will get to:**

* Work closely with and learn from experienced leaders across Sales, Marketing and Solutions Engineering
* Deeply understand and communicate PredictHQ's mission, value proposition and product offerings
* Build foundational outbound skills \- account research, personalised messaging and multi\-threading \- as your growth path toward an Outbound SDR role

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Respond \& Qualify:** Own fast, thorough follow\-up on all inbound marketing leads, speed\-to\-lead and quality of qualification are the core of this role
* **Learn \& Apply:** Master PredictHQ's qualification framework (ICP, use cases, buying signals) to consistently separate real opportunities from noise
* **Communicate \& Convert:** Run structured qualification conversations that uncover need, urgency, and fit, and convert qualified leads into meetings for Account Executives
* **Leverage Technology:** Build fluency in Salesforce, Gong, and LinkedIn Navigator to work leads efficiently and keep pipeline data clean and reliable
* **Support Strategic Accounts:** Prioritize and fast\-track any inbound signal from named strategic accounts, looping in the outbound team where relevant
* **Collaborate \& Learn:** Work closely with marketing to give feedback on lead quality and campaign performance, and with AEs to understand what "good" looks like downstream
* **Build Outbound Muscle:** Begin developing foundational outbound skills, account research, personalized messaging, multi\-threading, as a growth path toward an Outbound SDR role

**Results**

* **Speed \& Responsiveness:** Consistently meet or beat response\-time targets on inbound leads
* **Qualification Accuracy:** Convert inbound leads into meetings that AEs consider genuinely sales\-ready
* **Meeting Volume \& Quality:** Deliver a steady, reliable flow of qualified meetings, balancing throughput with conversation quality
* **Pipeline Contribution:** Directly contribute to pipeline and revenue growth through consistent, well\-qualified lead conversion
* **Sales \& Marketing Feedback Loop:** Surface insights that help marketing sharpen lead scoring, messaging, and campaign targeting
* **Growth Trajectory:** Demonstrate increasing command of qualification, objection handling, and early account research, the core readiness signals for promotion into an Outbound SDR role

**Must\-haves**

* 3\-6 months' experience in an SDR role
* Be able to communicate effectively and collaborate with internal teams
* Articulate complex business challenges in a clear and compelling way
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a strong drive for long\-term career growth
* Work independently with self\-motivation while actively contributing to the greater team
* Manage time effectively with strong organizational skills
* Drive business value and results with speed and efficiency

**Nice\-to\-haves**

* SaaS/API/Data Sales: 1 year
* Sales Experience: 1 year
* Experience using our key tools and platforms including Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn,
* Bachelor's Degree or prior experience exceeding quota as an SDR

**General**


* Applicants for this position must be a US citizen or have a valid United States work visa.
* Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with internal policies and procedures, applicable legislation, rules and standards, including relevant Acts, Advertising Standards Authority rules and regulations, and industry body requirements
* The total OTE range for hiring for this position is $80,000 \- $90,000, comprising a base and variable component
* This role is based in our San Francisco office. We believe strongly in the importance of in\-office collaboration and are not open to remote at this time. We work a hybrid structure of days in the office and from home

**Benefits**

* Health care and benefits administered by Sequoia One
* Paid Birthday Leave and Paid Family and Friends Day Leave
* Strong focus on your trainin

### **About TouchCare**



TouchCare is a healthcare concierge and benefits advocacy company making healthcare easier to navigate. For more than a decade, we've helped employees and their families understand and maximize their benefits while helping employers deliver a better healthcare experience.



Now, we're growing—and expanding our Sales team to help bring TouchCare to more employers across the country.


### **The Opportunity**



We're looking for a **Sales Development Representative (BDR)** to join our growing Sales team in **NYC.**



You'll be on the front lines of TouchCare's growth—connecting with brokers and benefits professionals, opening new relationships, and generating opportunities for our Sales team.



This is an opportunity to **learn B2B / B2C sales from experienced leaders, become an expert in the healthcare and benefits industry, and build toward an Account Executive career path.**


### **What You'll Do**


* Identify and connect with brokers, benefits professionals, and prospective partners through **phone, email, LinkedIn, and industry events**.
* Research target accounts and create thoughtful, personalized outreach.
* Qualify inbound and outbound prospects and generate meetings for our Sales team.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospects who may not be ready to buy today.
* Partner closely with Account Executives on messaging, account strategy, and prospecting.
* Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, and lead\-generation initiatives.
* Become an expert on TouchCare, our solutions, buyers, and competitive landscape.
* Maintain accurate activity and pipeline information in our CRM.
* Meet and exceed activity, meeting, and pipeline goals.

### **What You'll Bring**


* **2–5 years of sales, business development, or related experience**; B2B experience preferred.
* Strong communication skills and confidence starting conversations with new people.
* A competitive, goal\-oriented mindset and desire to succeed.
* Curiosity, coachability, resilience, and strong follow\-through.
* Ability to research prospects and create personalized outreach.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology, or SaaS experience is a plus.
* Excitement about working **onsite in our Stamford office five days per week**.

### **Why TouchCare?**



TouchCare has **10\+ years of success** behind us and an exciting period of growth ahead.



You'll join a collaborative team, work directly alongside experienced Sales and company leaders, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on our growth. We see Business Development as a **launching point for future sales talent**, with opportunities for high performers to grow into Account Executive and other sales roles as we scale.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator – Youth Sports
jobs.description:
**Event Operations Supervisor – Youth Sports**

Help create unforgettable experiences for young athletes

We are looking for an organized, energetic Event Operations Coordinator to help bring hundreds of youth sports events to life each year.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys turning plans into great experiences. You will help prepare events, coordinate equipment and materials, work with facilities and vendors, support staff and coaches, and solve the real\-time details that keep an event running smoothly. Some weeks will be carefully planned; others will ask you to adjust quickly. In both cases, your work will matter to the athletes, families, coaches, and teammates counting on us.

You do not need to arrive knowing every part of our operation. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, cares about the details, and is excited to learn how excellent events come together.

What you’ll do

* Coordinate the operational details that help youth sports camps and special events run successfully.
* Prepare event plans, checklists, timelines, materials, equipment, and shipments.
* Track event readiness and follow key details through completion so teams know what is ready and what still needs attention.
* Coordinate with facilities, vendors, coaches, event staff, and internal teams before and during events.
* Help manage inventory, organize event supplies, and make sure materials reach the right event at the right time.
* Support travel, lodging, arrival schedules, parking, certificates of insurance, payments, and other event needs as assigned.
* Provide clear, timely updates when plans change or a teammate needs help.
* Help guide interns and seasonal team members during busy preparation periods.
* Respond to occasional event questions during evenings or weekends in peak season.
* Improve checklists, processes, and shared information so each event becomes easier to prepare and execute.
* Pitch in wherever needed. Our best event operators care more about helping the team succeed than about whose task something is.

You may be a great fit if you

* Enjoy coordinating many moving pieces and bringing order to a busy environment.
* Follow through reliably and take pride in getting the details right.
* Communicate with warmth, clarity, and good judgment.
* Can adjust priorities when new information arrives without losing sight of the larger goal.
* Are comfortable working independently while also knowing when to ask for help.
* Like practical, hands\-on work and are willing to help prepare, organize, receive, and move event materials.
* Work well with different personalities, including coaches, vendors, interns, and teammates.
* Are comfortable learning tools such as Trello, spreadsheets, and event\-management systems.
* Care about youth sports and the opportunity to create meaningful experiences for student\-athletes.

Experience in event operations, sports management, hospitality, travel coordination, facilities, inventory, or a similarly detail\-oriented role is helpful—but we also welcome applicants whose skills come from another setting. If this work sounds energizing and you believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you will learn our event calendar, systems, and standards; become a trusted owner of assigned event\-readiness work; help seasonal staff stay organized; and give the team confidence that important details will be carried through to completion.

Over time, you will take greater ownership of events and operational categories, anticipate needs before they become urgent, and help build better ways of working across the Event Operations team.

What you can expect from us

* Purpose\-driven work that directly supports young athletes and their families.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* Real responsibility and the opportunity to grow within a large, national youth sports operation.
* Variety: every event cycle brings new people, locations, and challenges.
* Health insurance and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

Schedule and physical requirements

This position is based in Chicago and generally works from the office 3–4 days per week, with additional in\-person availability during peak event\-preparation and shipping periods. Because our events often occur on weekends, occasional evening or weekend responsiveness is part of the role.

The position also includes hands\-on work with event supplies and equipment, including receiving, organizing, packing, and moving materials. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals.

About Us

We empower youth athletes through sports, leadership, and personal\-development experiences. Each year, we work with thousands of athletes, families, coaches, facilities, and partners across the country. Behind every successful event is a team that plans carefully, communicates clearly, and cares deeply about the experience we create.

If you want your work to be active, meaningful, and connected to a mission—and you enjoy being the person who helps make everything come together—we would love to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**Location:** Chicago, Illinois (hybrid; typically 3–4 days per week in office)  
**Job type:** Full\-time

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $62,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions\-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carrier Sales Representative

**Roots Logistics \| Chicago, IL**  
**Full\-Time \| Monday through Friday (Days Vary)**

In This Role as a National Account Manager you will work alongside an experienced Carrier Sales team responsible for securing reliable transportation capacity, negotiating rates, building carrier relationships, and supporting the successful movement of customer freight throughout North America.

This is a hands\-on role that requires strong communication, urgency, organization, negotiation skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and carrier relationships at the same time. You will be expected to perform the full responsibilities of a National Account Manager while also placing a strong emphasis on identifying, developing, and maintaining new carrier relationships.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working within a close\-knit team environment while taking personal ownership of growing their carrier network. Success in this role requires someone who can service today’s freight while continuously building the carrier relationships Roots Logistics will need tomorrow.

We are looking for someone who views every carrier conversation as an opportunity to build trust, strengthen our network, and create a long\-term partnership.

**Working for Roots Logistics**

At other large companies, employees can easily get lost among numerous departments and layers of management. That is not the case at Roots Logistics.

Although we manage a large and complex transportation operation, we maintain a collaborative team structure that allows employees to communicate seamlessly across departments and locations. Regardless of your job title, you will play an important role in helping the company move forward, meet customer expectations, and continuously improve its operations.

Our National Account Managers work closely together, sharing information, supporting one another, and helping the team secure the best possible transportation solutions for our customers. This is an environment where teamwork matters, individual effort is recognized, and your ability to build strong carrier relationships can directly contribute to the company’s growth.

**About Roots Logistics**

Roots Logistics is a growing transportation and freight brokerage company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. We provide dependable transportation solutions throughout North America by combining an experienced operations team, an extensive carrier network, industry\-leading technology, and around\-the\-clock support.

Our operation is supported by team members in Chicago, Miami, Tampa, Colombia, Serbia, and the Philippines. This structure allows us to provide continuous coverage and responsive service to our customers and carrier partners.

Our vision is to be a progressive company within the complex logistics industry by providing reliable, solutions\-driven service that exceeds our customers’ expectations. We are committed to building long\-term partnerships while creating an environment where employees can develop professionally, expand their skills, and advance their careers.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Work alongside other National Account Managers in a highly collaborative and team\-oriented environment.
* Secure qualified carrier capacity for customer shipments throughout North America.
* Communicate with carriers, dispatchers, drivers, owner\-operators, and fleet managers regarding available freight and equipment.
* Negotiate competitive and sustainable transportation rates.
* Match available carrier capacity with customer freight based on location, equipment type, timing, service requirements, and pricing.
* Prospect for and develop relationships with new carriers.
* Build a personal network of dependable carrier partners that can support recurring and future freight opportunities.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing carriers.
* Conduct regular outbound calls to identify available equipment and new transportation partners.
* Use load boards, referrals, internal systems, industry contacts, and outbound prospecting to source carrier capacity.
* Present available freight clearly and professionally to prospective carrier partners.
* Understand carrier needs, preferred lanes, equipment availability, and operational capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to convert transactional carrier relationships into consistent, long\-term partnerships.
* Assist with carrier onboarding and ensure all required information and documentation are completed.
* Confirm that carriers meet company, customer, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before being assigned freight.
* Work closely with Operations, Tracking, Customer Sales, and other internal teams to support successful load execution.
* Communicate shipment requirements, appointment information, routing instructions, and customer expectations accurately.
* Confirm carrier acceptance and verify that all load details are clearly understood.
* Monitor assigned shipments and remain engaged throughout the transportation process.
* Assist with resolving carrier\-related delays, service failures, missed appointments, fall\-offs, and communication issues.
* Recover loads when a scheduled carrier cancels or is unable to complete an assignment.
* Maintain accurate carrier, rate, shipment, and communication records within the company’s Transportation Management System.
* Provide timely and accurate updates to internal team members.
* Monitor freight market conditions, carrier availability, capacity changes, and transportation pricing.
* Meet established activity, carrier development, gross margin, service, and performance expectations.
* Demonstrate consistent attendance, dependability, professionalism, and punctuality.
* Perform additional duties as business needs require.

**Qualifications**

* One year of previous freight brokerage, carrier sales, dispatch, transportation, logistics, or related experience preferred.
* Experience

This is a remote role within the United States. US work authorization is required.

 **About VIATechnik:**


VIATechnik is on a mission to lead the built environment in creating a better future, today. We are one team of over 500 digital experts around the globe. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed architects, engineers, tradespersons, researchers, and business leaders. Together, we empower clients through high\-quality, high\-velocity experiences that consistently improve outcomes across the design, construction, and operations of buildings and infrastructure. Our clients include Amazon, Mars Wrigley, and National Geographic, the firms shaping the world's most ambitious projects.

 **Role Overview**


As an Assistant Project Manager for mechanical and plumbing scopes, you will support the delivery of BIM and VDC services for VIATechnik's trade contractor clients. You'll coordinate between VIATechnik's internal technical teams and client stakeholders, manage several workstreams at once, and translate technical outputs into clear next steps for the people building the work in the field.


Your day\-to\-day work keeps handoffs on schedule, surfaces issues early, and manages risk before it affects a project timeline. This role fits someone with a strong grasp of construction software and technical workflows who wants to stay close to delivery without doing hands on production modeling.

 **Employee Value Proposition**

**Purpose** \- You will shape how predictably trade contractors operate in high\-stakes construction environments. The coordination you drive between technical teams and clients has a real effect on field readiness, clash avoidance, and schedule performance.

**Growth** \- Strong performance here opens a path to senior delivery leadership within VIATechnik's project portfolio. As you build expertise, you can take on process innovation, internal capability development, cross project delivery governance, or strategic account leadership.

**Motivators** \- You will thrive in this role if you find meaning in visible impact on client outcomes and enjoy being the connective force between technical teams and trade contractor clients, in a structured yet dynamic environment.

 **Major Performance Objectives**

* Within your first ninety days, get up to speed on each client's expectations and the project management platforms in use, and set a predictable rhythm of updates that keeps deliverables, dependencies, and reviews on track.
* Within your first sixty days, build a shared way of working with internal technical teams and client stakeholders, including regular check ins, a clear path for resolving issues, and agreement on scope and change requests.
* Within your first ninety days, contribute to at least one company wide initiative focused on process improvement, delivery standardization, or knowledge sharing, and help produce a measurable improvement that benefits VIATechnik beyond your own projects.

 **Critical Subtasks**

* Conduct a 30 to 60 day audit of your active projects to assess delivery status, scope clarity, modeling workflows, and risk areas, then work with technical leads to correct what needs fixing.
* Serve as a steady point of contact for trade contractor clients, keeping them updated on deliverable status, upcoming reviews, and open decisions.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and review cycles across your projects, flagging timeline risk early and adjusting resourcing with technical leads as needed.
* Run structured syncs with internal technical team leads to align on client feedback, modeling questions, and production challenges before they become bottlenecks.
* Watch for scope creep and change requests, document them clearly, and work with Client Success or Account Management to keep pricing and delivery aligned.
* Lead debriefs after major milestones or project closeout and turn what you learn into updates to templates, checklists, or delivery methods the team can reuse.
* Look for ways AI and automation tools can improve delivery accuracy and reduce manual coordination, and pilot at least one idea within your first six months.

 **This Role Is a Strong Fit for You If**

* A minimum of 2 years experience.
* An associate or above in a related field.
* You have hands on experience with construction software and BIM or VDC workflows and can translate technical detail into next steps that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* You can manage several active projects at once without losing track of deadlines, dependencies, or who owns what.
* You are comfortable being the connective point between technical teams and clients, and you take ownership when something needs to move faster.
* You work well in a structured environment that is still evolving, and you look for ways to improve the process rather than waiting to be told.

 **Culture and Situation Fit**


You will join a client\-centric, delivery\-focused organization that values ownership, adaptability, and proactive communication. The pace is fast, with simultaneous management of multiple projects, frequent coordination with technical experts, and rapid alignment of client expectations. Success requires comfort within a structured yet evolving operations framework and a strong sense of accountability for outcomes.

 **Win\-Win Statement**


If you succeed in this role, you will become a trusted delivery lead for multiple trade contractor clients, consistently meeting deadlines while improving how VIATechnik's teams work. In return, VIATechnik gains a scalable leader ready for broader portfolio responsibility, and you gain a clear path toward that next step.

* Health insurance with the choice of five plan opti

**Job Summary**

Uses skills as a seasoned and experienced administrative operations professional to manage, plan, and administer operational and facilities functions for the Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI), spanning several locations. Provides day\-to\-day operational coordination for CNEI, ensuring consistent standards, procedures, and working conditions across multiple CNEI locations. Demonstrates good judgment in independently coordinating operational and administrative processes and prioritizing multi\-site logistics.


**Department Overview**

The Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI) is a support department with five main divisions: Nursing Professional Development, Nursing Quality and Analytics, Clinical Practice, Nursing Continuous Improvement and Research, and Magnet Recognition Program®. The Professional Development team includes Nursing Professional Development Specialists who oversee the Department of Nursing’s training and education needs. The Nursing Practice team includes Clinical Nurse Specialists and Advanced Practice Specialists, who oversee evidence\-based practice standards that optimize quality and safety patient outcomes. The Research \& Scholarship team includes Nurse Scientists and a Scholarship Development Specialist who oversee the infrastructure for clinical inquiry, research, and innovation. The Nursing Continuous Improvement team oversees continuous improvement and evidence\-based practice processes across the system. The Nursing Quality and Analytics team includes nursing quality analysts who oversee data production, dissemination, and analytics. The Magnet Program Director collaborates with CNEI, Nursing leaders, and the Nursing Department to advance excellence in accordance with Magnet Recognition Program® standards. The mission of the CNEI team is to prepare and support UCSF nurses to be expert clinicians and authentic leaders who provide high\-quality, compassionate care, foster the spirit of clinical inquiry, promote professional development, and enhance a culture of diversity and inclusivity.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of administrative operations or facilities coordination experience.
* Thorough knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for facilities and logistics.
* Interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
* Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as supply purchasing, expense tracking, event planning, inventory, equipment, and facilities record keeping.
  

Solid knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs (Office 365, Drupal, ServiceNow).
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Strong skills in short\-term planning, analysis, problem\-solving, and customer service.
* Strong customer service orientation across all locations and able to run operations on competing site\-level priorities.
* Ability to coordinate and prioritize work across multiple locations with minimal supervision.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of workplace safety regulations and experience serving as site safety coordinator or liaison.
* Project management certification from a reputable organization such as PMP, CSM, or ACP to include a qualifying exam and/or quality assurance processes like Six Sigma or Lean or equivalent project management experience.

new_jobs.description:
**About PredictHQ**


AI and forecasting systems have a blind spot: the real\-world conditions that shift demand land as surprises instead of signals. PredictHQ closes that gap. We're the real\-world context platform trusted by some of the world's largest enterprises, including Uber, Expedia, and CVS, explaining more than 60 percent of real\-world demand variability so businesses can make high\-stakes decisions on pricing, staffing, and inventory with confidence.

**Our Values**


PredictHQ is about teamwork to achieve huge things. We are building innovative and complex products, so our empathetic, hard\-working culture is key to our success. We are proactive in helping our teammates grow and thrive in their careers, as well as making sure everyone can put their family and friends first.  

  



We’re looking for a driven and strategic Inbound Sales Development Representative to join our growing Go\-to\-market team in San Francisco.


As an Inbound SDR at PredictHQ, you’ll be on the front lines of our revenue engine, helping drive pipeline and business growth. As a key member of our Sales team, you’ll engage with our prospects, building relationships with key stakeholders in enterprise organizations. Your role goes beyond lead qualification \- you’ll deeply understand our mission, value proposition, and product offerings to spark high\-value conversations with senior executives.


We're a small but high\-impact team, so we need someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is eager to make an immediate impact. You'll be joining a group that's creative in how it builds account strategy and genuinely enthusiastic and supportive of each other day\-to\-day. You’re just as comfortable conducting targeted research and crafting compelling messaging as you are jumping on a demo call. You’ll master sales automation tools, qualify inbound leads, and execute a multi\-threaded sales strategy \- all while refining messaging and optimising campaign performance.

**As an Inbound Sales Development Representative at PredictHQ, you will get to:**

* Work closely with and learn from experienced leaders across Sales, Marketing and Solutions Engineering
* Deeply understand and communicate PredictHQ's mission, value proposition and product offerings
* Build foundational outbound skills \- account research, personalised messaging and multi\-threading \- as your growth path toward an Outbound SDR role

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Respond \& Qualify:** Own fast, thorough follow\-up on all inbound marketing leads, speed\-to\-lead and quality of qualification are the core of this role
* **Learn \& Apply:** Master PredictHQ's qualification framework (ICP, use cases, buying signals) to consistently separate real opportunities from noise
* **Communicate \& Convert:** Run structured qualification conversations that uncover need, urgency, and fit, and convert qualified leads into meetings for Account Executives
* **Leverage Technology:** Build fluency in Salesforce, Gong, and LinkedIn Navigator to work leads efficiently and keep pipeline data clean and reliable
* **Support Strategic Accounts:** Prioritize and fast\-track any inbound signal from named strategic accounts, looping in the outbound team where relevant
* **Collaborate \& Learn:** Work closely with marketing to give feedback on lead quality and campaign performance, and with AEs to understand what "good" looks like downstream
* **Build Outbound Muscle:** Begin developing foundational outbound skills, account research, personalized messaging, multi\-threading, as a growth path toward an Outbound SDR role

**Results**

* **Speed \& Responsiveness:** Consistently meet or beat response\-time targets on inbound leads
* **Qualification Accuracy:** Convert inbound leads into meetings that AEs consider genuinely sales\-ready
* **Meeting Volume \& Quality:** Deliver a steady, reliable flow of qualified meetings, balancing throughput with conversation quality
* **Pipeline Contribution:** Directly contribute to pipeline and revenue growth through consistent, well\-qualified lead conversion
* **Sales \& Marketing Feedback Loop:** Surface insights that help marketing sharpen lead scoring, messaging, and campaign targeting
* **Growth Trajectory:** Demonstrate increasing command of qualification, objection handling, and early account research, the core readiness signals for promotion into an Outbound SDR role

**Must\-haves**

* 3\-6 months' experience in an SDR role
* Be able to communicate effectively and collaborate with internal teams
* Articulate complex business challenges in a clear and compelling way
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a strong drive for long\-term career growth
* Work independently with self\-motivation while actively contributing to the greater team
* Manage time effectively with strong organizational skills
* Drive business value and results with speed and efficiency

**Nice\-to\-haves**

* SaaS/API/Data Sales: 1 year
* Sales Experience: 1 year
* Experience using our key tools and platforms including Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn,
* Bachelor's Degree or prior experience exceeding quota as an SDR

**General**


* Applicants for this position must be a US citizen or have a valid United States work visa.
* Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with internal policies and procedures, applicable legislation, rules and standards, including relevant Acts, Advertising Standards Authority rules and regulations, and industry body requirements

**Benefits**

* Health care and benefits administered by Sequoia One
* Paid Birthday Leave and Paid Family and Friends Day Leave
* Strong focus on your trainin

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

  

We are building a modern, end\-to\-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever\-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  



Powered by next\-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post\-purchase experience. ### **About TouchCare**



TouchCare is a healthcare concierge and benefits advocacy company making healthcare easier to navigate. For more than a decade, we've helped employees and their families understand and maximize their benefits while helping employers deliver a better healthcare experience.



Now, we're growing—and expanding our Sales team to help bring TouchCare to more employers across the country.


### **The Opportunity**



We're looking for a **Sales Development Representative (BDR)** to join our growing Sales team in **NYC.**



You'll be on the front lines of TouchCare's growth—connecting with brokers and benefits professionals, opening new relationships, and generating opportunities for our Sales team.



This is an opportunity to **learn B2B / B2C sales from experienced leaders, become an expert in the healthcare and benefits industry, and build toward an Account Executive career path.**


### **What You'll Do**


* Identify and connect with brokers, benefits professionals, and prospective partners through **phone, email, LinkedIn, and industry events**.
* Research target accounts and create thoughtful, personalized outreach.
* Qualify inbound and outbound prospects and generate meetings for our Sales team.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospects who may not be ready to buy today.
* Partner closely with Account Executives on messaging, account strategy, and prospecting.
* Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, and lead\-generation initiatives.
* Become an expert on TouchCare, our solutions, buyers, and competitive landscape.
* Maintain accurate activity and pipeline information in our CRM.
* Meet and exceed activity, meeting, and pipeline goals.

### **What You'll Bring**


* **2–5 years of sales, business development, or related experience**; B2B experience preferred.
* Strong communication skills and confidence starting conversations with new people.
* A competitive, goal\-oriented mindset and desire to succeed.
* Curiosity, coachability, resilience, and strong follow\-through.
* Ability to research prospects and create personalized outreach.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology, or SaaS experience is a plus.
* Excitement about working **onsite in our Stamford office five days per week**.

### **Why TouchCare?**



TouchCare has **10\+ years of success** behind us and an exciting period of growth ahead.



You'll join a collaborative team, work directly alongside experienced Sales and company leaders, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on our growth. new_jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator – Youth Sports
new_jobs.description:
**Event Operations Supervisor – Youth Sports**

Help create unforgettable experiences for young athletes

We are looking for an organized, energetic Event Operations Coordinator to help bring hundreds of youth sports events to life each year.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys turning plans into great experiences. You will help prepare events, coordinate equipment and materials, work with facilities and vendors, support staff and coaches, and solve the real\-time details that keep an event running smoothly. Some weeks will be carefully planned; others will ask you to adjust quickly. In both cases, your work will matter to the athletes, families, coaches, and teammates counting on us.

You do not need to arrive knowing every part of our operation. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, cares about the details, and is excited to learn how excellent events come together.

What you’ll do

* Coordinate the operational details that help youth sports camps and special events run successfully.
* Prepare event plans, checklists, timelines, materials, equipment, and shipments.
* Track event readiness and follow key details through completion so teams know what is ready and what still needs attention.
* Coordinate with facilities, vendors, coaches, event staff, and internal teams before and during events.
* Help manage inventory, organize event supplies, and make sure materials reach the right event at the right time.
* Support travel, lodging, arrival schedules, parking, certificates of insurance, payments, and other event needs as assigned.
* Provide clear, timely updates when plans change or a teammate needs help.
* Help guide interns and seasonal team members during busy preparation periods.
* Respond to occasional event questions during evenings or weekends in peak season.
* Improve checklists, processes, and shared information so each event becomes easier to prepare and execute.
* Pitch in wherever needed. Our best event operators care more about helping the team succeed than about whose task something is.

You may be a great fit if you

* Enjoy coordinating many moving pieces and bringing order to a busy environment.
* Follow through reliably and take pride in getting the details right.
* Communicate with warmth, clarity, and good judgment.
* Can adjust priorities when new information arrives without losing sight of the larger goal.
* Are comfortable working independently while also knowing when to ask for help.
* Like practical, hands\-on work and are willing to help prepare, organize, receive, and move event materials.
* Work well with different personalities, including coaches, vendors, interns, and teammates.
* Are comfortable learning tools such as Trello, spreadsheets, and event\-management systems.
* Care about youth sports and the opportunity to create meaningful experiences for student\-athletes.

Experience in event operations, sports management, hospitality, travel coordination, facilities, inventory, or a similarly detail\-oriented role is helpful—but we also welcome applicants whose skills come from another setting. If this work sounds energizing and you believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you will learn our event calendar, systems, and standards; become a trusted owner of assigned event\-readiness work; help seasonal staff stay organized; and give the team confidence that important details will be carried through to completion.

Over time, you will take greater ownership of events and operational categories, anticipate needs before they become urgent, and help build better ways of working across the Event Operations team.

What you can expect from us

* Purpose\-driven work that directly supports young athletes and their families.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* Real responsibility and the opportunity to grow within a large, national youth sports operation.
* Variety: every event cycle brings new people, locations, and challenges.
* Health insurance and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

Schedule and physical requirements

This position is based in Chicago and generally works from the office 3–4 days per week, with additional in\-person availability during peak event\-preparation and shipping periods. Because our events often occur on weekends, occasional evening or weekend responsiveness is part of the role.

The position also includes hands\-on work with event supplies and equipment, including receiving, organizing, packing, and moving materials. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals.

About Us

We empower youth athletes through sports, leadership, and personal\-development experiences. Each year, we work with thousands of athletes, families, coaches, facilities, and partners across the country. Behind every successful event is a team that plans carefully, communicates clearly, and cares deeply about the experience we create.

If you want your work to be active, meaningful, and connected to a mission—and you enjoy being the person who helps make everything come together—we would love to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**Location:** Chicago, Illinois (hybrid; typically 3–4 days per week in office)  
**Job type:** Full\-time

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $62,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Inside Sales function is responsible for creating, developing and converting demand for NCC Group's Cyber Security solutions. Success is measured through the generation of qualified pipeline, growth of new client relationships, accurate opportunity progression and effective collaboration with Marketing and Sales teams to deliver revenue outcomes. The SDR function serves as the first commercial point of contact for prospective clients and plays a critical role in creating opportunities that progress into qualified sales engagements.  

  

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for identifying, engaging, qualifying and nurturing potential customers through inbound and outbound prospecting activity. The role generates qualified sales opportunities through cold outreach, social selling, marketing campaign execution and relationship building, ensuring a consistent flow of opportunities into the commercial pipeline.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Lead Generation*** Consistently identify and engage target prospects through outbound activity.
* Generate agreed levels of net\-new meetings, leads and opportunities.
* Demonstrate effective prospecting, research and multi\-channel outreach skills.

**Lead Qualification*** Assess opportunities against defined qualification criteria.
* Apply strong questioning and discovery skills to determine customer fit and buying intent.
* Progress qualified opportunities to sales teams within agreed conversion targets.

**Campaign Execution*** Deliver marketing and self\-generated demand campaigns.
* Execute outreach activities aligned to target audiences and objectives.
* Track and optimise campaign performance against activity and conversion metrics.

**Relationship Development*** Build and maintain credible relationships with prospective customers.
* Engage multiple stakeholders through effective communication and follow\-up.
* Nurture opportunities to increase engagement and progression rates.

 **Pipeline Development*** Create and progress a pipeline of qualified opportunities for commercial teams.
* Maintain visibility of pipeline performance through accurate forecasting data.
* Achieve agreed opportunity creation, conversion and progression metrics.

**CRM \& Process Excellence*** Maintain accurate and timely CRM records.
* Ensure high standards of data quality, compliance and pipeline hygiene.
* Produce reliable information to support reporting, forecasting and decision\-making.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Able to evidence success in a sales, recruitment, business development or customer\-facing commercial environment, with clear examples of generating opportunities, engaging prospects or influencing customer decisions.
* Confident using phone, email and social channels to identify, engage and convert prospective customers into qualified conversations or agreed next steps.
* Able to maintain accurate prospect, activity and opportunity data in CRM systems, supporting effective follow\-up, reporting and pipeline visibility.
* Able to communicate clearly, concisely and professionally with prospects and internal stakeholders, adapting messaging to create interest and drive action.
* Able to quickly learn Cyber Security concepts and translate them into customer\-relevant messaging that links services to business challenges and outcomes.

### **Job Benefits**

  

* Flexible \& hybrid working options
* Financial \& Investment
* 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
* Health Insurance contributions
* Life Assurance
* Maternity \& Paternity leave
* Community \& Volunteering Programmes
* Employee Referral Program
* Lifestyle \& Wellness
* Learning \& Development

### **About NCC Group**


We assess, develop and manage cyber threats across our increasingly connected society. We advise global technology, manufacturers, financial institutions, critical national infrastructure providers, retailers and governments on the best way to keep businesses, software and personal data safe.  

  

With our knowledge, experience and global footprint, we are best placed to help businesses identify, assess, mitigate \& respond to the risks they face.  

  

We are passionate about making the Internet safer and revolutionising the way in which organisations think about cyber security.  

  

Headquartered in Manchester, UK, with over 35 offices across the world, NCC Group employs more than 2,000 people and is a trusted advisor to 15,000 clients worldwide.  

We review every application received and will get in touch if your skills and experience match what we’re looking for. If you don’t hear back from us within 10 days, please don’t be too disappointed – we may keep your CV on our database for any future vacancies and we would encourage you to keep an eye on our career opportunities as there may be other suitable roles.  

  

If you do not want us to retain your details, you can utilise the Manage Your Data tool provided by Pinpoint or contact us directly at: global.ta@nccgroup.com. All personal data is held in accordance with the NCC Group Privacy Notice.  

  

We are committed to diversity and flexibility in the workplace. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the application process, please tell us at any stage.  

  

**Please note that this role involves mandatory pre\-employment background checks due to the nature of the work NCC Group does. To apply, you must be willing and able to undergo the vetting process.**
